requirements.text: WHEN the process list exceeds the available window height, the system shall keep the current overview metrics visible and confine vertical scrolling to the process table.
WHEN live snapshots arrive, the system shall show accessible CPU and memory trends from at most the latest 60 available samples without fabricating missing values.
The frontend trend buffer shall contain no more than 60 samples and shall not alter Rust sampling, persistence, or alert evaluation.
Trend visualizations shall expose non-color accessible names and range descriptions.

scenarios.title: Overview remains visible while processes scroll
scenarios.given: Given the live process table contains more rows than fit in the native window
scenarios.when: When the user scrolls the process list
scenarios.then: Then only the process table scrolls while system statistics and process controls remain visible

scenarios.title: Metric trends show recent live samples
scenarios.given: Given multiple CPU and memory snapshots have arrived
scenarios.when: When the user views the system metric cards
scenarios.then: Then accessible CPU and memory trends show up to the latest 60 available samples

obligations.title: Render bounded accessible live metric trends
Confine dashboard scrolling to the process table

testPlans.title: Fixed overview and metric trend regression coverage
Native fixed overview and scroll ownership journey
